title: Plant-based
summary: Vegan: no meat, fish, eggs, dairy or honey.
description: Every meal is made from plants: beans, lentils, chickpeas, tofu, whole grains, nuts, seeds, vegetables and fruit. Choose calcium-fortified soya milk where you can.
highlights: Beans, lentils and tofu for protein
caution: Eating no animal foods? Take a vitamin B12 supplement or eat B12-fortified foods every day: there is no reliable plant source of B12.
